notes.title: Pharmageddon: release date announced
notes.notes:
We are thrilled to announce the upcoming release of Pharmageddon set to launch on October 20, 2023. This unprecedented gaming experience challenges your compassion, decision-making, and empathy.

In Pharmageddon you'll find yourself in an otherworldly dimension, a realm inhabited by opioid zombies – creatures driven by an insatiable craving for relief from their worldly tribulations. However, you won't be their adversary; instead, you will assume the role of their compassionate guardian. Your mission is one of enlightenment, not annihilation.

As the keeper of this realm, you are tasked with leading your flock of opioid zombies, each burdened by the weight of their past choices, towards the elusive nirvana they seek – a realm of serenity and release from the shackles of their earthly pains. You must navigate the intricate pathways of their redemption, making critical decisions that balance their yearning for solace with the preservation of their fragile existence.

But the journey won't be without challenges and obstacles. Dark shadows lurk, threatening to derail their path to salvation. As their guide, you must find the delicate equilibrium between compassion and discipline, ensuring the safety of your flock as you steer them toward their ultimate destination.

Pharmageddon invites players to immerse themselves in a profound and contemplative gaming experience. Will you be the shepherd of these lost souls, leading them towards salvation in a world filled with sorrow? The fate of the opioid zombies rests in your hands.

Stay tuned for more updates and get ready to guide opioid zombies towards their elusive nirvana.
